title: Adoption survives slow, red and non-GitHub repositories and reports failing standards as gaps
body:
Why: adoption census #787 (evals/adoption-census.md) on 15 operator repositories: adopt's canary has no own timeout (perfect-memory: 124 after 180s, leaves .krn/conventions.json); a red clean tree (missing deps in mise-en-plesk, lsn2-map, wycena-master) is reported as 'Stop gate does not pass the clean tree after restore: exit 2', indistinguishable from a gate defect; adopt writes .agents/standards.json and its own standards check is immediately red in 15/15 (s-test-command, s-ci-runs-tests, s-linter-configured) with no gap reported; adopt --verify with a non-GitHub origin (krn-zakupy) fails expanding {owner}/{repo}. Census ran before #782 (vacuous contract) merged.
Outcome: adopt's canary has a bounded timeout with a named exit and removes what it wrote on failure; a red clean tree is reported as a red base with the failing command, distinct from a gate failure; adopt prints every failing standard as a gap and writes one tracker task per floor/reflex failure; verify on a non-GitHub origin prints a clear 'no GitHub host' line and skips the CI checks; the census script rerun on main reproduces evals/adoption-census.md.
Proof: fixture tests for each case; census rerun table committed; npm run fast PASS.
